authority.claim_ceiling: scope decision + source identity records only; not runtime, performance or module-acceptance evidence

pilots.why: recorte TOWN1 já inventariado pelo doador (perfis gal_town*), texto/modelos com hash, fila de eventos analisada; melhor custo de primeiro slice real
mede generalização real (perfil bt_rescue; pré-flight de tiles próprio, nativo rejeitado vs legado 880 tiles/512 px): não é o mesmo código com outro nome

pilot_decision.rule: Mudança de pacote/modelo deve gerar dados sem editar C do núcleo por identidade do módulo; ampliar o contrato quando novas features forem implementadas; não alegar universalidade com dois casos.

openbor_pin.scope: conditional semantic reference (partial hash-verified extract); NOT evidence of the original module runtime and NOT the demonstrated origin of the PAKs

license_boundary.scope: porting provenance and reuse of tooling patterns; does not license module assets or character IP
conditional semantic reference for queue/font/image semantics; partial extract, not full checkout
external origin/version unknown; exists the importer license does not license redistributing the game or its characters; assets stay in donor scratch; nothing here is publishable

capability_boundary.note: host-side reader; full PAK never resident on SMS; fresh hash/index verified by intake
types/cost rewritten for Z80; animation windows preserved with source origin
host analysis preserved; IR carries path/line/bytes/hash
typed queue with owners (O4); cursor never advances without consuming the event
module scenarios/scroll adapted; not a stage-free adaptation
@script text is not implemented; reach analysis in O1; unknown reachable code blocks acceptance, no silent noop
6-bit palette, cutout, metasprites; identity-changing edits need decision and review
tracked re-authoring/transcription; channel arbitration; no auto-conversion of WAV/BOR/OGG to PSG
1P first; 2P is a separate capability with its own test/budget if contracted (never promoted with 1P-only proof)
measure per SMS ROM; donor MD measurements are NOT SMS evidence
O8; no module is accepted while an essential owner is missing/unknown; an accepted phase requires all reachable owners
matrix-only capability; own lowering policy declared in the TDD; source slot 1 first, spillover documented

profile_boundary.scope: profiles are cuts, not compatibility claims; they anchor tests and diffs, not acceptance

intake_hygiene.explicit_paths_only: intake tooling requires explicit --path/--file/--dir/--tree arguments; no implicit donor path, no MUGEN project path is required, and no third-party EIO media is touched
intake_hygiene.registration: locations data/source_openbor/ and data/generated/ were declared in doc/artifact_registry.json before any write into them; every managed file is registered with SHA-256

acceptance_rule: Fix the broad versioned compatibility contract for each pilot before implementation; do not narrow it to obtain a green result. A module is complete only when all reachable essential features required by that contract are implemented or explicitly adapted, all resource/script dependencies are resolved, no essential reachable feature is unknown or silently omitted, the generated build is reproducible, and the declared gameplay/audio/hardware evidence passes for that ROM hash.

next_batch.goal: neutral front-end: PAK/model/level IR with origin, diffs and invalid cases; MD emission kept separate
